label: GitHub Notification
description: A thread in the notifications of the person who owns the GitHub token the connector reads them with. Read only; its body is the title of what it concerns and its sender the repository, and it is connected to the synced issue, pull request or discussion it concerns.

reason.description: Why GitHub notified the person, as GitHub names it, such as mention, review_requested or subscribed. It changes when a later notification on the thread has another reason.

unread.description: Whether the thread is unread on GitHub.

github_updated_at.description: When GitHub last changed the thread.

last_read_at.description: When the person last read the thread. Empty until they have.

subject_type.description: What the thread concerns, as GitHub names it, such as Issue, PullRequest, Discussion, Commit or Release.

url.description: The address on GitHub of what the thread concerns. Empty for a kind of subject with no page of its own to name.

private.description: Whether the repository the thread is in is private on GitHub, as of the last read: a row marked private holds what is not public, and its contents are not to be copied into a public place.
